Morning a short update for busy families
With that in mind
Travelers, please check animal papers before arrival. Our Companion Animal Travel Desk is sorting pet bookings with care, and we need clean records, prompt replies, and calm handoffs at the counter.

Pet travel notice

If you are bringing a large dog, <<FACT F057>> Keep the carrier or lead ready for inspection, and make sure the pet is settled before you reach the desk. Staff will note any service changes in the ledger and pass the details along without delay.

If you are traveling with a cat, <<FACT F079>> <<FACT F061>> Bring the crate that matches the booking, and keep health papers close at hand. Clear paperwork helps the line move faster, and it helps us protect the animal and the cabin plan.

If you need a last review, come to the Companion Animal Travel Desk before check in. We will look over the documents, confirm the arrangement, and guide you to the right counter.
